Hi Marco / Neha — quick checklist for the pen-test artifact upload and S3 conventions:

- S3 path pattern: s3://redwood-evidence/finflow/DF-783/{yyyyMMdd}_{uploaderInitials}_{artifactType}.{ext}
- File types preferred: pdf, png, txt, csv; please avoid full database dumps.
- Minimal metadata: uploader name, role, uploaded_at timestamp included in the object metadata or as a companion .metadata file.
- Access window: we will request read-only permissions for the pen vendor for a 72-hour window post-handoff.

Marco — if that pattern works, reply-all with your preferred uploader initials and we'll provision the bucket path before the call.

Olga will cover the pen-test scope during the walkthrough and collect any specific artifact requests.

Thanks,
